Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you please state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather keep my name off this one, if that's okay. You can just refer to me as the driver of the vehicle.
Q: That works for our file. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was making a left turn across the opposing lane when another
vehicle hit the side of my car.
Q: What was the traffic signal doing when you started your turn?
A: I had a green arrow for the left turn. I'm pretty sure of that. I waited for the oncoming cars to clear before I moved.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. It came around the corner qucikly and I heard the brakes right before it hit. I didn't have time to react.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How are you feeling since the collision?
A: My neck and upper back are really sore. I've been stiff when I wake up, and turning my head to check mirrors
hurts. The doctor said it looks like whiplash.
Q: Have you started any treatment?
A: I've been going to physical therapy twice a week, and I'm taking anti-inflammatory medication. My doctor wants me
to keep going for a few more weeks and see how it goes.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful during the turn and I'm hoping this gets resolved so I can get back to normal driving and
work.
</page>
